name: Steam Girls
description:
Collect the puzzle pieces of adorable Steam Girls and complete the puzzles!

Total of 15 stages
The difficulty increases as you clear stages!

Stages 1–10: 30 pieces
Stages 11–15: 50 pieces
The final stage is a challenging level with no background watermark to guide you!
Carefully examine each piece and lead the puzzle to completion!
When you complete a puzzle, high-quality images of the Steam Girls will be added to the gallery♪
=====================
Our company supports content creators and streamers who wish to showcase our games.
You do not need to obtain permission to create gameplay videos or stream this game.
